summary: The discussion addressed the integration of network layer inputs into OAM systems, emphasizing a strategy to leverage existing network OAM while focusing new efforts on measuring CATS system performance. A subsequent presentation detailed security considerations for CAS version 4, identifying risks such as man-in-the-middle attacks, fake instance registration, and denial-of-service threats within functional components like the CSMA agent. Recommendations included deploying the CSMA in trusted zones behind firewalls and enforcing rate limiting to mitigate these vulnerabilities.
